name: Sieve Figurative
overview: The Bible uses the imagery of a sieve to illustrate God's refining and testing of His people and nations. Isaiah 30:28 and Amos 9:9 depict God sifting the nations and Israel like grain, separating and purifying without losing any of His people. Similarly, in Luke 22:31, Jesus warns Simon Peter that Satan desires to sift him like wheat, emphasizing the spiritual trials believers face. Together, these verses reveal the sieve as a powerful metaphor for divine judgment and spiritual testing that ultimately serves God's purpose of purification and preservation.
